name: Tendou Akane
source: The third daughter of the Tendō family and Ranma's predetermined fiancée by parental arrangement. Though she rebels against the forced engagement, she constantly meddles in Ranma's life—denying her feelings yet stubbornly sticking by his side. Her cooking skill is notoriously terrible.
translation: The third daughter of the Tendō family and Ranma's predetermined fiancée by parental arrangement. Though she rebels against the forced engagement, she constantly meddles in Ranma's life—denying her feelings yet stubbornly sticking by his side. Her cooking skill is notoriously terrible.
